## v0.3.0 — 2026-11-06
- Start with a guided sample, recording permissions, and model setup. Skip setup when ready, or reopen it from General settings.\ 首次使用可分步体验示例、了解录音权限并配置模型；可稍后设置，也可从通用设置重新进入。 - Keep pending model and recording preferences in sync between onboarding and Settings.\ 首次引导与设置窗共享未保存的模型和录音偏好，切换入口继续编辑。 - Read earlier captions without new content pulling you to the bottom. A new-caption hint takes you back to the latest text and resumes following.\ 回看历史字幕时保留阅读位置；出现新内容时轻提示，点击回到最新并恢复跟随。 - Remember the caption window position for each display and keep restored windows within the visible screen area.\ 按显示器记忆字幕窗位置，重开恢复时保持窗口处于屏幕可见区域。
Local builds, automated checks, and native UI verification are documented in the [first-use](docs/verification/first-use.md) and [caption-window](docs/verification/caption-window.md) records, including remaining hardware checks.\ 本地构建、自动化检查和原生界面验收见[首次使用](docs/verification/first-use.md)与[字幕窗](docs/verification/caption-window.md)记录，包含待补的实机检查。

## v0.2.3 — 2026-11-03
- Reduce runaway repetition in local Qwen transcription with a mild repetition penalty and a generation budget based on audio duration.\ 为本地 Qwen 转写加入轻度重复惩罚，并按音频时长限制生成长度，减少异常复读。 - Report an error when Qwen exhausts its generation budget, preserve completed chunks and diagnostics, and let you retry from the unfinished chunk.\ Qwen 耗尽生成额度时明确报错，保留已完成分块与诊断信息，可从未完成的音频块继续重试。

## v0.2.2 — 2026-11-03
### English
- Blend the library and Settings title bars into their content in dark mode, matching the unified appearance in light mode. Keep native window controls and content spacing when switching appearance or reopening windows.
### 中文
- 修复资料库与设置窗在深色模式下顶部色带分割的问题，标题栏与正文融合，浅色外观保持一致。切换外观、关闭重开时保留原生窗口按钮和正文间距。
